\section[a roupa]{a roupa — clothes}

\label{lesson:PT-C77-roupa}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Portuguese for a theatre, then the Portuguese for a library.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: a roupa}
\textbf{a roupa} — \textquotedblleft{}clothes\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{roupa} $\leftarrow$ Gothic \emph{raupa}, \textquotedblleft{}spoils, plunder\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB 2.1) — borrowed. Clothes were once what you took as plunder.
\end{cousinweb}
